# Schema Reference\n\n> Authoritative data model. All models live in /server/src/models/. NEVER create parallel models.\n\n---\n\n## User\n\n| Field | Type | Notes |\n|---|---|---|\n| _id | ObjectId | Auto-generated |\n| name | String | required, trimmed |\n| email | String | required, unique, lowercase |\n| passwordHash | String | bcrypt hash, NEVER stored plain |\n| role | String | enum: ADMIN, STAFF, CHEF |\n| active | Boolean | default true — soft-disable |\n| createdAt/updatedAt | Date | Mongoose timestamps |\n\n## Table\n\n| Field | Type | Notes |\n|---|---|---|\n| _id | ObjectId | Auto-generated |\n| number | Number | required, unique |\n| capacity | Number | required, min 1 |\n| status | String | FREE, OCCUPIED, BILLED, CLEANING |\n| qrToken | String | signed JWT {tableId, number} — Rule 2 |\n| currentSessionId | ObjectId | ref: TableSession, nullable |\n\n## MenuItem\n\n| Field | Type | Notes |\n|---|---|---|\n| _id | ObjectId | Auto-generated |\n| name | String | required |\n| category | String | Starters/Mains/Breads/Drinks/Desserts |\n| description | String | default empty |\n| basePrice | Number | required, min 0 — Rule 1 source of truth |\n| variants | Array | [{name, priceDelta}] |\n| addOns | Array | [{name, price}] |\n| imageUrl | String | default empty |\n| isVeg | Boolean | default true |\n| available | Boolean | default true — soft-delete flag |\n| avgPrepMinutes | Number | default 10 |\n\n## TableSession\n\n| Field | Type | Notes |\n|---|---|---|\n| _id | ObjectId | Auto-generated |\n| tableId | ObjectId | ref: Table, required |\n| startedAt | Date | default Date.now |\n| closedAt | Date | nullable |\n| runningTotal | Number | default 0 |\n| status | String | OPEN, BILL_REQUESTED, PAID, CLOSED |\n\n## Order\n\n| Field | Type | Notes |\n|---|---|---|\n| _id | ObjectId | Auto-generated |\n| orderType | String | DINE_IN, TAKEAWAY |\n| source | String | QR, KIOSK, STAFF |\n| sessionId | ObjectId | ref: TableSession, nullable |\n| tableNumber | Number | denormalised, nullable |\n| token | Number | daily takeaway token, nullable — Rule 5 |\n| items | Array | [OrderItem] subdocuments |\n| subtotal | Number | server-recalculated — Rule 1 |\n| specialInstructions | String | default empty |\n| status | String | PLACED, CLAIMED, COMPLETED, SERVED, COLLECTED, CANCELLED |\n| claimedBy | ObjectId | ref: User CHEF, atomic — Rule 3 |\n| claimedAt | Date | nullable |\n| completedAt | Date | nullable |\n| servedAt | Date | nullable |\n| createdAt | Date | Mongoose timestamp |\n\n### OrderItem (embedded)\n\n| Field | Type | Notes |\n|---|---|---|\n| menuItemId | ObjectId | ref: MenuItem |\n| name | String | denormalised at order time |\n| variant | String | selected variant or empty |\n| addOns | [String] | selected add-on names |\n| qty | Number | min 1 |\n| unitPrice | Number | basePrice + variantDelta, server-calculated |\n| lineTotal | Number | unitPrice*qty + addOn prices*qty |\n\n## Bill\n\n| Field | Type | Notes |\n|---|---|---|\n| _id | ObjectId | Auto-generated |\n| sessionId | ObjectId | ref: TableSession, nullable |\n| orderId | ObjectId | ref: Order, nullable |\n| subtotal | Number | required |\n| cgst | Number | 2.5% of subtotal, 2dp — Rule 9 |\n| sgst | Number | 2.5% of subtotal, 2dp — Rule 9 |\n| serviceCharge | Number | default 0 |\n| discount | Number | default 0 |\n| total | Number | subtotal+cgst+sgst+serviceCharge-discount |\n| status | String | UNPAID, PAID |\n\n## Payment\n\n| Field | Type | Notes |\n|---|---|---|\n| _id | ObjectId | Auto-generated |\n| billId | ObjectId | ref: Bill, required |\n| mode | String | ONLINE, CASH |\n| status | String | PENDING, SUCCESS, FAILED |\n| collectedBy | ObjectId | ref: User, nullable (CASH mode) |\n| txnRef | String | gateway ref, default empty |\n| paidAt | Date | set only after server verification — Rule 8 |\n\n## DailyCounter\n\n| Field | Type | Notes |\n|---|---|---|\n| date | String | YYYY-MM-DD, unique |\n| counter | Number | atomically incremented via  — Rule 5 |\n\n## Relationships\n\n`\nUser         --< Order          (claimedBy)\nTable        --< TableSession   (tableId)\nTable        --< Order          (tableNumber, denormalised)\nTableSession --< Order          (sessionId)\nTableSession --< Bill           (sessionId)\nOrder        --< Bill           (orderId)\nBill         --< Payment        (billId)\nMenuItem     --< OrderItem      (menuItemId, embedded in Order)\n`
